reasons.plausibility: Linking superconductivity to the electronic density of states and coherent electronic states is broadly consistent with established superconductivity theories, though more detail on coupling mechanisms would strengthen it.
reasons.testability: Measuring resistivity and susceptibility below 10 K provides a clear, standard method to confirm or refute the predicted superconducting transition.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a straightforward framework and experiment to assess superconductivity in a novel high-entropy alloy, making it a worthwhile avenue to explore.
